description.narrative:
ACFODE Core Support from We Effect (2025-2028) Through We Effect's core support, Action for Development (ACFODE) will implement key priorities of its 2024-2030 Strategic Plan, which seeks to remodel and consolidate efforts toward resilient and sustainable gender equality and women's empowerment in Uganda. The three-year support (2025-2028) will strengthen Acfode's institutional capacity, deepen its advocacy for gender-responsive governance, and enhance inclusive participation of women and youth in leadership and decision-making.
Core support enables ACFODE to act strategically and flexibly advancing its mission through integrated interventions in leadership development, women's economic security, climate justice, and peacebuilding. It will strengthen internal systems, diversify income sources, and improve monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) for greater efficiency and sustainability. By 2028, ACFODE aims to achieve increased women's agency and voice, strengthened gender-responsive policies, improved economic empowerment for women and youth, and enhanced institutional resilience to sustain long-term impact. The core funding will also allow ACFODE to mentor grassroots organisations, promote gender-transformative social norms, and foster alliances that challenge inequality and advance social justice across Uganda. Overall, We Effect's core support positions ACFODE to effectively deliver on its strategic plan and sustain its leadership in gender equality advocacy nationwide.
